structured_output.analysis: The base recipe iso_3.15 has a measured KL of 0.4361 (E514ab09c524e). It already uses the full size budget, so every upgrade has to be paid for with a downgrade. The biggest losses are in MLP layers. Three of them have a cheap 1-bit upgrade with a large single-layer KL drop: 27.up_proj (gptq_int3 0.00572 → gptq_int4 0.00217), 27.gate_proj (rht_gptq_int3 0.00499 → rht_gptq_int4 0.00153) and 14.down_proj (rht_gptq_int2 0.00633 → rht_gptq_int3 0.00181). To pay for them I use the tabled attention o_proj and k_proj downgrades, whose predicted KL cost is only about 1e-5 to 5e-5 each. The analysis does not show those layers' current methods, so the bit savings are an estimate and these proposals may be refused as over budget. I also test act_order=true for the GPTQ methods, which costs no bits.

proposals.name: swap_mlp3_fund_oproj
proposals.rationale: Upgrades three high-loss MLP layers by 1 bit: 27.up_proj gptq_int3 0.0057182 (Ef04d8aa7bded) → gptq_int4 0.00216589 (Efea8c18d2abc); 27.gate_proj rht_gptq_int3 0.00498703 (Efa0bb391da67) → rht_gptq_int4 0.00153131 (Ef428ac081334); 14.down_proj rht_gptq_int2 0.00633466 (E4c3f9b73e065) → rht_gptq_int3 0.00181478 (E90bd4b2f3645). Predicted gain is about 0.0115. The bits come from tabled attention downgrades, each with a predicted KL cost of 5e-5 or less. Base KL is 0.43614 (E514ab09c524e).

proposals.name: iso_actorder
proposals.rationale: Turns on act_order=true for every GPTQ method; this costs no bits. Activation kurtosis is high in the loss layers: 1090.09 (E24beed188b6a) and 324.063 (Ecbd8d8937247). Base KL is 0.43614 (E514ab09c524e).

proposals.name: swap_mlp3_actorder
proposals.rationale: Combines the funded MLP swaps with act_order=true. Base KL is 0.43614 (E514ab09c524e).
